name: Symbiosis (Kobold Press/Open Design)
body:
School transmutation; Level alchemist 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 day/level

DESCRIPTION

You sprout mushrooms or other self-replenishing fungus on the backs of your hands and arms. This fungus can provide you with nourishment for the duration of the extract’s effects, removing without penalty the need to eat or drink.
